subject.title: perf: optimize Dockerfile layers and convert config I/O to non-blocking async

question: Should maintainers require the Docker packaging repair in this mixed PR, or split the async config I/O change into a narrower PR?
rationale: The branch mixes a plausible config I/O cleanup with Docker packaging changes that affect build compatibility and security-sensitive image contents, so a maintainer should choose the acceptable merge shape before this continues.

options.title: Repair packaging in this PR
options.body: Require the contributor to rebase, restore the final runtime stage, remove `.npmrc` from runtime copies, keep typed provider fixtures, and provide real Docker/config proof before merge.

options.title: Split config from Docker
options.body: Ask for a narrow async config I/O PR and leave Docker layer consolidation for a separate packaging PR with build/run proof.

options.title: Pause or close the branch
options.body: Hold this PR if the contributor cannot rebase and supply proof, while inviting a fresh narrow PR for the useful config cleanup.

recommendation.title: Repair packaging in this PR
recommendation.body: Require the contributor to rebase, restore the final runtime stage, remove `.npmrc` from runtime copies, keep typed provider fixtures, and provide real Docker/config proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Docker/config path history makes this the best available owner for the mixed packaging and config merge-risk choice.
